RESOURCES ( 9 )
STAY AHEAD OF WHAT’S NEXT
Discover which brands lead AI visibility across 22 industries

And why winning in the US doesn’t guarantee success in the UK.

News
Introducing Adobe Brand Visibility — Built for the Age of AI search

The first unified GEO solution brings together Semrush data and Adobe's agentic tools, giving marketers visibility, competitive insight, and content optimization in one workflow.

News
Product Update
Semrush Launches the AI Search Operating System

A free playbook to get your brand found, understood and recommended in AI search. 41 lessons, 10+ templates, and a 90-day action plan built for SEO and marketing leaders.

News
Playbook
Semrush Announces Partnership with Lovable

Semrush integrates its search data directly into Lovable, the AI software creation platform, giving all Lovable users access to SEO and AI visibility tools natively inside the builder.

News
Product Update
Adobe Completes Semrush Acquisition

Adobe acquires Semrush to unify brand visibility, SEO, and AI-driven customer experience — helping businesses stay discoverable and drive engagement in an agent-led digital landscape.

News
FAQ for Customers: Adobe Acquires Semrush

Answers to the most important customer questions — covering what changes, what stays the same, and what to expect next from Adobe and Semrush.

News
Direct Access to Semrush Data in ChatGPT

The go-to integration to streamline daily tasks and centralize your data. Faster insights, smarter workflows, and visibility built right in to where you work.

News
Product Update
How We’re Driving LLM Visibility at Semrush

How we nearly tripled our AI share of voice and boosted our AI visibility with Enterprise AIO and the AI Visibility Toolkit. A systematic approach with real data.

Article
Sharpen Your Digital Marketing Skills with Our Free Webinars

A free certification course on how AI is changing search. Track prompts, optimize for LLMs, and grow your brand’s visibility in AI search.
